sources.title: Wireshark User Guide
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Zeek：conn、DNS 與 TLS 日誌關聯
related.titleEn: Zeek: correlating connection, DNS and TLS logs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種位元組數可重算且非完整pcap大小；所有結論附擷取範圍、截斷與丟包限制。 交付擷取設定、截斷/丟包統計與可分享的去識別封包摘要。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both byte counts are reproducible and not claimed as total pcap size; conclusions include scope, truncation and packet-loss limits. Deliver capture settings, truncation/loss statistics and shareable pseudonymous packet summaries.
related.difference: 建立合成conn.log、dns.log與ssl.log三張表；先按uid連結同一連線，再用明示時間窗處理DNS名稱關係，不只靠IP猜測。
related.differenceEn: Create synthetic conn.log, dns.log and ssl.log tables; first join connection records by uid, then relate DNS names within an explicit time window rather than guessing from IP alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 截斷後可保存的封包位元組近似N×snaplen，另需檔案記錄開銷；被擷取過濾排除的資料不能靠顯示過濾找回。 合成10000包，每包原長度均大於256位元組；snaplen=128，只算封包資料。 10000×128=1280000位元組；snaplen改256後為2560000位元組。
可關聯率=具有必要共同鍵且可唯一連結的事件/總事件；共享IP與快取DNS會使名稱推論不唯一。 合成500個TLS事件中，420個有可唯一關聯的conn uid，80個缺失或重複。 420/500×100=84%；修正50個後470/500×100=94%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Truncated packet-byte storage is approximately N×snaplen plus file-record overhead; display filters cannot recover packets excluded at capture. There are 10000 synthetic packets, each longer than 256 bytes; snaplen is 128 and only packet data is counted. 10000×128=1280000 bytes; snaplen 256 yields 2560000 bytes.

Joinability is events with required keys and a unique join divided by all events; shared IPs and cached DNS can make name inference ambiguous. Of 500 synthetic TLS events, 420 uniquely join to a connection uid and 80 are missing or duplicated. 420/500×100=84%; repairing 50 gives 470/500×100=94%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MITRE ATT&CK：行為假說與可驗證偵測範圍
related.titleEn: MITRE ATT&CK: behavior hypotheses and verifiable detection scope
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種位元組數可重算且非完整pcap大小；所有結論附擷取範圍、截斷與丟包限制。 交付擷取設定、截斷/丟包統計與可分享的去識別封包摘要。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both byte counts are reproducible and not claimed as total pcap size; conclusions include scope, truncation and packet-loss limits. Deliver capture settings, truncation/loss statistics and shareable pseudonymous packet summaries.
related.difference: 只選與虛構學院環境相關的20個行為假說，以合成日誌描述可觀察條件；逐項列資料來源、偵測邏輯、測試與盲點，不重演真實入侵。
related.differenceEn: Select 20 behavior hypotheses relevant to a fictional academy and express observable conditions through synthetic logs; list source, detection logic, test and blind spot without reenacting intrusion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 截斷後可保存的封包位元組近似N×snaplen，另需檔案記錄開銷；被擷取過濾排除的資料不能靠顯示過濾找回。 合成10000包，每包原長度均大於256位元組；snaplen=128，只算封包資料。 10000×128=1280000位元組；snaplen改256後為2560000位元組。
受測覆蓋率=已有正例與正常負例通過的假說/事先選定假說；不能將本地分母與完整ATT&CK技術總數混用。 教學範圍20個假說，其中12個完成正負例驗證，其餘8個未完成。 12/20×100=60%；補完4個後16/20×100=80%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Truncated packet-byte storage is approximately N×snaplen plus file-record overhead; display filters cannot recover packets excluded at capture. There are 10000 synthetic packets, each longer than 256 bytes; snaplen is 128 and only packet data is counted. 10000×128=1280000 bytes; snaplen 256 yields 2560000 bytes.

Tested coverage equals hypotheses passing positive and normal-negative fixtures divided by preselected hypotheses; do not mix the local denominator with the full ATT&CK catalog. The teaching scope contains 20 hypotheses, 12 validated with positive and negative fixtures and 8 unfinished. 12/20×100=60%; completing four more yields 16/20×100=80%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
